boundaries: No new training, inference, data, seed or independent confirmation
Folds overlap in training; seeds reuse the same validation patients; counts are descriptive, not independent replications for a binomial test
Stage adjustment is a rank-association sensitivity, not a causal intervention on depth
Within-stage correlations have four branches; large coefficients do not establish patient-wise selection accuracy
No p-values, patient confidence intervals or noninferiority claims are computed from aggregate cells
This check does not test whether one branch alone drives the association

methods.comparison: Signed removal association minus absolute forced-path association; ties within 1e-12
methods.spearman: Pearson correlation of average-tie ranks within each bank/subset
methods.stage_adjusted_ranks: Rank all 12 cells within a bank; subtract each stage's mean rank separately for weight and endpoint; correlate residuals
methods.within_stage_ranks: Rank the four branches separately in each bank-stage; correlate the concatenated three rank vectors
